  "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,

  "properties": {

  "allOf": [

        "if": {"properties": {"completion": {"const": "complete"}}},
        "then": {"properties": {"history": {"properties": {"status": {"enum": ["bundled", "remote-verified"]}}}}}
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {"properties": {"identity": {"properties": {"kind": {"const": "global"}}}}},
      "then": {"properties": {"repository": {"type": "null"}, "ref": {"type": "null"}, "head": {"type": "null"}, "base": {"type": "null"}}}
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "text": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 4096, "pattern": "^[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\\ud800-\\udfff]+(?![\\s\\S])"},
    "token": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128, "pattern": "^(?![\\s\\S]*\\.\\.)[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}(?![\\s\\S])"},
    "identity": {

    },
    "file": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["relpath", "size", "sha256", "mode"],
      "properties": {

        "file": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/relpath"}, {"type": "null"}]},
        "size": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10737418240},
        "sha256": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/sha256"}, {"type": "null"}]},
        "ref": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/ref"}, {"type": "null"}]},
        "head": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/oid"}, {"type": "null"}]},
        "remote_oid": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/oid"}, {"type": "null"}]},
        "remote_evidence": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/text"}, {"type": "null"}]}
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {"properties": {"status": {"const": "bundled"}}},
          "then": {"properties": {
            "file": {"$ref": "#/$defs/relpath"}, "size": {"minimum": 1},
            "sha256": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sha256"}, "ref": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ref"}, "head": {"$ref": "#/$defs/oid"}
          }},
          "else": {"properties": {"file": {"type": "null"}, "size": {"const": 0}, "sha256": {"type": "null"}}}

          "then": {
            "required": ["remote_oid", "remote_evidence"],
            "properties": {"remote_oid": {"$ref": "#/$defs/oid"}, "remote_evidence": {"$ref": "#/$defs/text"}, "head": {"$ref": "#/$defs/oid"}, "ref": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ref"}}

          "else": {"properties": {"remote_oid": {"type": "null"}, "remote_evidence": {"type": "null"}}}
